input.text: Your loop is summing up the list, but think carefully about which positions in the list it actually visits. In Python, list positions start at zero, so the very first item lives at index 0 — make sure your loop includes it rather than starting one step later.

content.text: Your results confirm the diagnosis: every test is off by exactly the first number, because the sum loop skips the element at index 0. I've given a level-1 hint about Python's zero-based indexing so the student can spot it themselves.
